kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتكد (form VIII)
# أَعْتَكِدُ (ʔaʕtakidu) /ʔaʕ.ta.ki.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# أُعْتَكَدُ (ʔuʕtakadu) /ʔuʕ.ta.ka.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# أَعْتَكِدَ (ʔaʕtakida) /ʔaʕ.ta.ki.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# أُعْتَكَدَ (ʔuʕtakada) /ʔuʕ.ta.ka
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
